final: WITH o AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS a FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark HAVING AVG(remaincount) IS NOT NULL), ov AS (SELECT AVG(remaincount) AS m FROM orderexecutions), g AS (SELECT AVG(o.a) AS m2 FROM o, ov WHERE o.a > ov.m) SELECT AVG(o.a) AS avg_of_avgs, AVG(o.a - ov.m) AS avg_excess_over_overall, AVG(o.a - g.m2) AS avg_excess_over_group_avg FROM o, ov, g WHERE o.a > ov.m AND o.a > g.m2
